info.title: http-server-sim
info.description: A .NET tool that runs a Web API simulating HTTP endpoints, supporting the development and testing of components that use HTTP.

options.name: --ControlUrl
options.description: URL for managing rules dynamically. Optional. Example: http://localhost:5001.

options.name: --DefaultContentType
options.description: Content-Type used in the default response when no rule matches the request.

options.name: --DefaultContentValue
options.description: Content used in the default response when no rule matches the request.

options.name: --DefaultDelayMin
options.description: Delay in milliseconds before sending the default response when no rule matches the request. Default: 0.

options.name: --DefaultDelayMax
options.description:
Maximum delay in milliseconds before sending the default response when no rule matches the request.
When --DefaultDelayMax is specified, the actual delay will be a random value between --DefaultDelayMin and --DefaultDelayMax.

options.name: --DefaultStatusCode
options.description: HTTP status code used in the default response when no rule matches the request. Default: 200.

options.name: --LogControlRequestAndResponse
options.description: Whether control requests and responses are logged. Default: false.

options.name: --LogRequestAndResponse
options.description: Whether requests and responses are logged. Default: true.

options.name: --RequestBodyLogLimit
options.description: Maximum request body size to log (in bytes). Default: 4096.

options.name: --ResponseBodyLogLimit
options.description: Maximum response body size to log (in bytes). Default: 4096.

options.name: --Rules
options.description: Rules file. This can be a file in the current directory or a full path to a file.

options.name: --SaveRequests
options.description: The directory where request messages are saved.

options.name: --SaveResponses
options.description: The directory where response messages are saved.

options.name: --Url
options.description:
URL used by the simulator for endpoint requests. Default: http://localhost:5000.
--Url and --ControlUrl cannot share the same value.
